system.description:
Glacial Jump: Once per turn, when you use Reflective Movement to teleport to an Ice Mirror, it costs you no movement. Additionally, You can use the effects of Mirrored Strike, to make melee attacks, against creatures up to 15 feet away from your Ice Mirrors as if they were within your melee attacks range.

Hostile Terrain: You gain a rank of Mastery to Initiative. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you create difficult terrain with a Hijutsu you cast or feature you use, hostile creatures take 5 cold damage for each space they pass through and allied creatures are immune to the effects of the difficult terrain.

Rime Line: When you move, you leave behind a layer of rime on the surface you are moving on and all adjacent surfaces. This rime melts at the beginning of your next turn.
